# KERYX Workspace Instructions

- Preserve the offline-first boundary: presentation and live output must not depend on AI or cloud services.
- Keep domain code modular and avoid giant components as the React/TypeScript migration begins.
- Treat AI as probabilistic; detections require confidence, source, timestamp, and an operator action.
- Use the existing control-room visual language: strong grid, restrained borders, high information density, and calm dark navigation.
- Do not ship copyrighted Bible translations, songs, or media without an explicit licensing/import path.
- Validate each vertical slice with a runnable check before expanding scope.
